Restore the mutated file from its copy and judge the outcome from a test report, or record a green report as the baseline (mutate judge)

USAGE mutate judge [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

                       --dir=<dir>    Target directory (Default: .)                                                                                     
                           --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)                                                                 
                          --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)                                                                              
                         --id=<id>    The id of the applied mutation to restore and judge                                                               
                        --baseline    Record a green report as the baseline apply requires (Default: false)                                             
                 --report=<report>    The test report the runner wrote, in the format named by --format                                                 
  --format=<vitest-json|junit-xml>    The report format: vitest-json (the runner's json reporter) or junit-xml (Default: vitest-json)                   
                     --card=<card>    The card the mutation verifies (#<n> or <n>): after the verdict, append a mutation-judged line for it to --journal
               --journal=<journal>    The journal --card appends to (default: ~/.construct/handoff/ghosts.jsonl)                                        
                            --json    Machine-readable report (Default: false)
